title: How Tibo built $1M/month SaaS products with zero original ideas
summary: Tibo explains how he validates ideas by shipping many products fast, building tools he uses himself, and making each one 10x better at a single thing. He also covers single-price pricing, affiliates, user DMs for feedback, and why distribution compounds across a product portfolio.

principles.text: Validate by shipping a new product every week until something sticks, instead of polishing one idea for years.
principles.quote: the thing that I did when I when I got back to startuping is try to ship one new product every week until something actually stick.

principles.text: Ideas aren't the edge. Make the product 10x better at one specific thing than competitors.
principles.quote: my edge is building great products um that are like at least 10 times better at a specific thing compared to the competition

principles.text: Be great at one thing that users value; being average at everything else is fine.
principles.quote: You have to do one thing extremely well like you have to be great at one thing and then you can be just average or good at everything else.

principles.text: Build products you use yourself daily so you fix real friction and understand the core need.
principles.quote: build products where I am the users. By doing that, I was able to use the product every single day and to solve all the little friction that I had

principles.text: Audience follows success, not the reverse. Validation needs only a few DMs and replies, not thousands of followers.
principles.quote: I have a big audience because I had a successful product.

principles.text: Offer one price or an obvious no-brainer choice; higher prices attract more serious, loyal customers.
principles.quote: the more choices you offer to users, the harder it is for them to actually um convert and subscribe.
